Q4: qualifier/Q4/ledger.ts exports createLedger({cap}) -> {post({key, account, amount}) -> {id, duplicate}, balance(account) -> string}. Amounts are positive integers as strings, cap too. The same key with the same payload is posted once (the second time duplicate is true, with the same id); the same key with another payload throws; a post that would take an account above cap throws and changes nothing.

House rules: TypeScript, tests with node:test run by tsx, each test named after the acceptance item it proves (A1, A2...), tests must fail without the change, no secrets, Latin digits only, no long dashes in any text people see.

response.notes: Implemented ledger with positive integer string validation, cap enforcement, duplicate handling, and comprehensive tests covering all acceptance criteria and edge cases.
